universe: all stored equity/ETF and crypto symbols with bars; catalog-only symbols separately retained in coverage
priority: production PRIORITY as exported at snapshot time
equities: stored split/dividend-adjusted OHLC; raw volume; source/feed retained
crypto: stored OHLC with actual source retained; verify Coinbase expectation
first_decision: first reporting-window bar with 250 prior structurally valid daily bars
first_fill: next available asset open after first decision close; buy-hold uses same earliest executable open
active_budget: prior account equity / number of currently eligible symbols, including flat symbols
buy_hold_budget: initial capital / frozen count of stored-price members in scope; reserve late/insufficient-history allocations as cash
entry_funding: one prior-cash snapshot; proportional competing requests; reserve entry costs; same-day exit proceeds unavailable for entries
units: fixed fractional units from entry until native exit; no leverage, pyramiding or implicit daily rebalance
cost_atr: latest completed bar before execution; each actual fill charged once
stop: entry fill minus 3 times signal-bar Wilder ATR20 for initial-stop long candidates; adverse gaps fill at open; scheduled exits before intraday stops
marks: last available close; held stale marks flagged; no new funding when prior price age exceeds 7 calendar days
terminal: mark open P&L; no invented terminal exit or exit fee
cagr: calendar time including cash; portfolios start on common reporting calendar, standalone comparisons start on common asset decision date
input_issues: never silently clip or repair; exclude structurally invalid symbols from trading but preserve reserved membership/coverage; material unresolved price flags make affected portfolios provisional
recalled_2x_position_test: unverified provenance; not evidence of instrument leverage safety; no archived files retrieved
future_exposure_tests: separate from doubled costs; exact instrument, reset, financing and failure rules required before execution
production_changes: none from research runs; new research contracts and PM implementation are separate checklist tasks
